The shop

Start with a room.

The shop is arranged as rooms rather than one long list. Each room has its own page showing what is listed there now.

  • 01 →

    Herbal Botanicals

    Plants chosen for daily ritual, described by what is known and what still needs checking.
  • 02 →

    Everyday Care

    The objects that meet you every morning: cleansing bars, oils and quiet daily care.
  • 03 →

    Showpieces

    Exceptional pieces that don't belong to a single aisle: wooden showpieces, meditative candles, organic ornaments. Chosen one by one, for what they are.
  • 04 →

    Yoga & Practice

    Mats, props and practice objects made to be used, not displayed.
  • 05 →

    Art & Craft

    Handmade pieces with a visible hand, a named maker and a traceable origin.
  • 06 →

    Quiet Living

    Simple objects for a room that asks less of you: stone, linen, wood and light.
